chapter.title: Ores and Mining
subtitle: Vanilla ore is still down there. Geolosys buries the rest in beds.
Find the sample, read the depth, take the whole seam in one swing.

hover: Three iron across, two sticks down.
Copper. The widest bed in the valley.
Diamond. A pipe, not a pocket.
Nine blocks a swing. Sneak for one.

quests.title: Take a Hammer Down, Not a Pickaxe
quests.subtitle: One swing clears three blocks by three.
description: Craft a &aStone Hammer&r. It breaks a 3x3 face in one hit, so a tunnel that cost nine swings costs one.
Bram keeps one on the peg at the mill: Act I, step 3. This one is yours.

quests.title: Carry 64 Torches and 16 Ladders
quests.subtitle: Light behind you, not just ahead.
description: Stock &a64 Torches&r and &a16 Ladders&r before you go down. Set a torch on the right-hand wall every eight blocks and the right wall walks you back out.
A ladder shaft beats a staircase: one block wide, straight up.

quests.title: Take a Whole Seam in One Swing
quests.subtitle: Hold the key above Tab while it breaks.
description: Hold the &bgrave key&r, the one above Tab, and break one ore. Everything joined to it comes with it, up to 64 blocks.
Bring &a32 Coal&r up to show for it. It costs tool durability and a little hunger, nothing else.

tasks.title: A whole seam taken in one swing.

quests.title: Read the Ground for Ore Samples
quests.subtitle: Speckled stones sitting out on the grass.
description: Geolosys buries ore in wide beds and leaves a small sample stone on the grass over each one. Break twelve iron samples for &aIron Clusters&r.
This is the reading Bram set you in Act I, step 5.

quests.title: Craft a Prospector's Pick
quests.subtitle: Three iron, two sticks, a straight answer.
description: Craft a &aProspector's Pick&r: three iron across the top, two sticks down. Right-click stone with it and it names what is buried within nine blocks.
It never wears out. Carry it and stop guessing.

quests.title: Smelt 32 Iron From a Hematite Bed
quests.subtitle: Hematite runs y 32 to 60, any biome.
description: Work a hematite bed between &by 32 and y 60&r. Every ore drops an Iron Cluster, and a cluster smelts into one &aIron Ingot&r.
Hematite is a dike: narrow and tall. Follow it up and down, not sideways.
Do not smelt a second bed by hand. The &6Thermal&r chapter reaches a Pulverizer in four quests and every ore after that is worth two.

quests.title: Hang an Iron Hammer on Your Belt
quests.subtitle: Five ingots. It pays itself back by teatime.
description: Craft an &aIron Hammer&r. Same 3x3 face, far more durability, and it takes the harder stone the first one refuses.
Sneak while you swing and it breaks a single block instead.

quests.title: Chase Beryl Under the Mountains
quests.subtitle: Green ore, thin dike, four emeralds.
description: Look for beryl samples on mountain ground and follow the dike down. It runs &by -56 to 19&r and drops &aEmeralds&r, not clusters.
Teallite beds carry a little beryl too, deeper and hotter.

quests.title: Find Autunite Between y 8 and 33
quests.subtitle: Yellow crust on mountain stone.
description: Prospect mountain stone between &by 8 and y 33&r for autunite. Each ore drops a &aUranium Cluster&r, and one cluster smelts to one ingot.
Sixty-four of these run Josie's vessel: see the &6Reactor&r chapter.

quests.title: Follow Malachite Down for Copper
quests.subtitle: The widest bed here: y -16 to 90.
description: Work a malachite bed for &a24 Copper Clusters&r. Malachite sits anywhere from &by -16 to y 90&r, so the sample may be under your own field.
Azurite is the same metal further down, below y 13. Vein-mine it with the grave key and the bed comes up in a handful of swings.

quests.title: Smelt Eight Tin and Eight Lead
quests.subtitle: Cassiterite in sand, galena under plains.
description: Smelt &a8 Tin Ingots&r from cassiterite and &a8 Lead Ingots&r from galena. Cassiterite sits &by 44 to 68&r under sandy ground; galena runs &by -16 to 32&r under plains.
Bronze and electrum both start in these two beds: Act III, step 9.

quests.title: Pull Silver Out of the Galena
quests.subtitle: One bed, two metals, no second hole.
description: Keep working the galena bed. It drops lead and silver from the same ore, so &a6 Silver Ingots&r cost you nothing but the time.
Silver goes into signalum and into every Thermal augment worth having.

quests.title: Sink Below y 10 for Kimberlite
quests.subtitle: A diamond pipe. Half of it is dead rock.
description: Dig below &by 10&r and look for kimberlite. It is a narrow pipe running down toward bedrock, and only half of it carries anything.
Bring &a6 Diamonds&r up. The pick finds the pipe faster than a strip mine ever will.

quests.title: Reforge the Hammer in Diamond
quests.subtitle: The last one you make for a long while.
description: Craft a &aDiamond Hammer&r now the kimberlite has paid out. Nine blocks a swing, and enough durability to cut a reactor pit in one sitting.
Put Efficiency on it before Fortune. Speed is what a hammer is for.
After this the upgrade is not another hammer — it is the &aFlux Drill&r off stored power, in the &6Thermal&r chapter. It never wears out at all.

quests.title: Dig the Sky Stone at -216, 72
quests.subtitle: About 110 blocks east of the farm hearth.
description: Walk east to &b-216, 72&r and dig. A meteorite is buried there under a shell of &aSky Stone&r, with a chest of presses at the middle of it.
The presses matter more than the stone: see the &6Storage Network&r chapter.

quests.title: Double the Ore in a Pulverizer
quests.subtitle: Two dust from one ore, and stray nickel.
description: Build a &aPulverizer&r and run iron through it until you hold &a16 Iron Dust&r. Two dust to the ore, and nickel drops out of it now and then.
What powers it lives in the &6Thermal&r chapter. Bram set the valley's first one running in Act II, step 13.

rewards.title: Ore, Doubled
rewards.description: Next: dynamos, ducts and the induction smelter, in the Thermal chapter.
